Fallback may select an ineligible task and cannot repair arbitrary queue corruption or guarantee fairness; native caller retries NULL, which could spin on inconsistent nonempty accounting. Deferred-once diagnostic suppresses repeated steady-state output; concurrent first calls may still duplicate the message. New skip-preempt adaptation preserves LTS origin tracking, but vendor callbacks remain trusted kernel code and can alter fields/weights or defer indefinitely. No native LTS fix reversed.
